import bisect,collections,hashlib,json,os,struct,subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root=Path.cwd();folder=root/'.cache/cad-native-simd'
binary=root/'.cache/cad-bookkeeping/public/build/cad-public'
policy=json.loads((folder/'policy.json').read_text())
symbols={}
def symbol_table(path):
    if path in symbols:return symbols[path]
    rows=[]
    for dynamic in (False,True):
        output=subprocess.run(['nm','-S','-n','-C','--defined-only',*(['-D'] if dynamic else []),path],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
        for line in output.splitlines():
            pieces=line.split(maxsplit=3)
            if len(pieces)==4 and pieces[2].lower() in ('t','w','i'):
                try:rows.append((int(pieces[0],16),int(pieces[1],16),pieces[3]))
                except ValueError:pass
        if rows:break
    rows.sort();symbols[path]=(rows,[r[0] for r in rows])
    return symbols[path]

def summarize(path):
    pc_text,map_text=path.read_text().split('maps\n')
    dropped=int(pc_text.splitlines()[0].split()[1]);assert dropped==0
    maps=[]
    for line in map_text.splitlines():
        columns=line.split(maxsplit=5)
        if len(columns)<6:continue
        lo,hi=[int(x,16) for x in columns[0].split('-')]
        file=columns[5];offset=int(columns[2],16)
        # Translate executable mapping offsets using the ELF PT_LOAD header.
        bias=lo-offset
        if Path(file).is_file():
            with open(file,'rb') as f:
                header=f.read(64)
                if header[:5]==b'\x7fELF\x02':
                    phoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',header,32)[0]
                    size,count=struct.unpack_from('<HH',header,54)
                    f.seek(phoff);headers=f.read(size*count)
                    for i in range(count):
                        kind,flags,off,vaddr,paddr,filesz,memsz,align=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',headers,i*size)
                        if kind==1 and flags&1 and (off&~4095)<=offset<(off+filesz+4095)&~4095:
                            bias=lo-(vaddr+offset-off);break
        maps.append((lo,hi,bias,file))
    counts=collections.Counter();total=0;raw=[]
    for line in pc_text.splitlines()[1:]:
        pc,n=line.split();pc=int(pc,16);n=int(n);total+=n
        label='[unmapped]'
        for lo,hi,bias,file in maps:
            if lo<=pc<hi:
                address=pc-bias;rows,starts=symbol_table(file)
                index=bisect.bisect_right(starts,address)-1
                if index>=0 and address<rows[index][0]+rows[index][1]:
                    label=Path(file).name+':'+rows[index][2].split('(')[0]
                else:label=Path(file).name+':[unknown]'
                break
        counts[label]+=n
    return dict(samples=total,dropped=dropped,functions=[dict(symbol=k,samples=v,percent=100*v/total) for k,v in counts.most_common()])

report=dict(scope='SIGPROF PC self samples, nominal 1 ms process CPU interval; whole process including mandatory verification and extra scalar recheck; instrumentation timings excluded. Inlined functions are attributed to enclosing symbols.',binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sampler_source=(folder/'sample_pc.c').read_text(),results=[])
for name in policy['cases']:
    case='full-bank-'+name;work=folder/'profile'/case;work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    input=root/'.cache/cad-bookkeeping/candidate'/case/case/'input.txt'
    reference=root/'.cache/cad-bookkeeping/candidate'/case/case/'final.answer'
    env=os.environ.copy();env['LD_PRELOAD']=str(folder/'sample_pc.so');env['CAD_NATIVE_PROFILE']=str(work/'samples.txt')
    command=['taskset','-c','0',str(binary),'final',str(input),str(work/'answer'),'6']
    print('START',case,flush=True)
    with (work/'stdout').open('w') as out,(work/'stderr').open('w') as err:
        subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err,check=True,timeout=1800)
    rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (work/'stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows)==6 and all(x['check_ok'] for x in rows)
    assert set((work/'answer').read_text().splitlines())==set(reference.read_text().splitlines())
    item=dict(case=case,command=command,answers_match=True,profile=summarize(work/'samples.txt'))
    report['results'].append(item)
    (folder/'profile.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('DONE',case,'samples',item['profile']['samples'],flush=True)
    for row in item['profile']['functions'][:12]:print(round(row['percent'],2),row['symbol'][:180],flush=True)
report['script']=Path(__file__).read_text()
(folder/'profile.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

"""Build two frozen variants, then interleave complete accepted CAD runs."""
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,shutil,statistics,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from benchmarks.harness.measure import run

folder=root/'.cache/cad-native-simd'
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
policy=load(folder/'policy.json')
validation={str(o):load(folder/f'validation-O{o}.json') for o in (0,3)}
assert all(r['passed'] for r in validation.values())
baseline=root/policy['baseline_public'];original=load(baseline/'manifest.json')
assert digest(baseline/'cad-public')==original['binary_sha256']
for name,checksum in original['sources'].items():assert digest(baseline/name)==checksum,name
changed={str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in (root/'src').rglob('*.mojo') if original['sources'].get(str(p.relative_to(root)))!=digest(p)}
assert changed=={'src/polynomials/_cad_native.mojo','src/polynomials/_cad_interval_roots.mojo','src/polynomials/_cad_final_codec.mojo'},changed
codec='src/polynomials/_cad_final_codec.mojo'
assert (root/codec).read_bytes().rstrip(b'\n')==(baseline/codec).read_bytes().rstrip(b'\n')

builds={'original':dict(directory=str(baseline),manifest=original)}
for mode in ('packed-scalar','simd'):
    directory=folder/mode/'build';directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    paths=set(original['sources'])|{str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in (root/'src').rglob('*.mojo')}
    hashes={}
    for name in sorted(paths):
        data=(root/name).read_bytes()
        if name=='src/polynomials/_cad_interval_roots.mojo' and mode=='packed-scalar':
            assert data.count(b'_shift_native[True](coefficients)')==1
            data=data.replace(b'_shift_native[True](coefficients)',b'_shift_native[False](coefficients)')
        hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    manifest=directory/'manifest.json';binary=directory/'cad-public'
    if manifest.exists() and binary.exists():
        saved=load(manifest)
        assert saved['sources']==hashes and digest(binary)==saved['binary_sha256']
        for name,checksum in hashes.items():assert digest(directory/name)==checksum
        print('REUSE BUILD',mode,flush=True)
    else:
        for name in sorted(paths):
            dest=directory/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(root/name,dest)
        source=directory/'src/polynomials/_cad_interval_roots.mojo'
        if mode=='packed-scalar':source.write_text(source.read_text().replace('_shift_native[True](coefficients)','_shift_native[False](coefficients)'))
        command=[part.replace(str(baseline),str(directory)) for part in original['command']]
        print('BUILD',mode,flush=True)
        with (directory/'compile.log').open('w') as output:
            subprocess.run(command,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
        saved=dict(command=command,sources=hashes,binary_sha256=digest(binary),compiler=subprocess.check_output(['mojo','--version'],text=True).strip(),revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),variant=mode,
                   variant_edit='One compile-time call selects the scalar specialization of the identical packed transform.' if mode=='packed-scalar' else 'Current working sources.')
        for name,checksum in hashes.items():assert digest(directory/name)==checksum
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(saved,indent=2)+'\n')
        print('BUILT',mode,flush=True)
    builds[mode]=dict(directory=str(directory),manifest=saved)

print('ALL COMPILATION FINISHED; BEGIN TIMINGS',flush=True)
comparisons=[];records=[]
for case_index,name in enumerate(policy['cases']):
    case='full-bank-'+name
    source=root/'.cache/cad-bookkeeping/candidate'/case/case
    input=source/'input.txt';expected=set((source/'final.answer').read_text().splitlines())
    expected_record=load(source.parent/'report.json')['results'][0]['records'][0]
    keys=('cells_by_level','cells','stacks','factors','compact','revision15','materializations','field_map_hits','max_field_degree','construction_retries','native_nodes','wide_nodes','exact_fallbacks')
    timings={mode:[] for mode in builds}
    for repetition in range(policy['repetitions']):
        order=list(builds);rotation=(repetition+case_index)%len(order);order=order[rotation:]+order[:rotation]
        for mode in order:
            work=folder/'runs'/case/mode/str(repetition);work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            binary=Path(builds[mode]['directory'])/'cad-public'
            fingerprint=dict(binary=digest(binary),input=digest(input),repetition=repetition)
            saved_path=work/'record.json'
            if saved_path.exists():
                item=load(saved_path);assert item['fingerprint']==fingerprint
            else:
                resource=run([str(binary),'final',str(input),str(work/'answer'),'1'],cwd=root,env=os.environ.copy(),timeout_s=policy['timeout_s'],memory_bytes=None,cpu=policy['cpu'],stdout=work/'stdout',stderr=work/'stderr').as_dict()
                assert resource['returncode']==0 and not resource['timed_out'],(case,mode,resource)
                rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (work/'stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
                assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['check_ok']
                item=dict(case=case,mode=mode,repetition=repetition,fingerprint=fingerprint,record=rows[0],resource=resource,answer_sha256=digest(work/'answer'))
                saved_path.write_text(json.dumps(item,indent=2)+'\n')
            assert digest(work/'answer')==item['answer_sha256']
            assert set((work/'answer').read_text().splitlines())==expected
            assert all(item['record'][key]==expected_record[key] for key in keys),(case,mode)
            records.append(item);timings[mode].append(item['record']['accepted_ns']/1e9)
        print('DONE',case,repetition+1,flush=True)
    summary={mode:dict(median_s=statistics.median(values),range_s=[min(values),max(values)],raw_s=values) for mode,values in timings.items()}
    base=summary['original'];simd=summary['simd'];scalar=summary['packed-scalar']
    allowance=max(.05,2*(base['range_s'][1]-base['range_s'][0])/base['median_s'])
    item=dict(case=case,timings=summary,simd_vs_original=simd['median_s']/base['median_s']-1,simd_vs_packed=simd['median_s']/scalar['median_s']-1,allowed_regression=allowance,within_tolerance=simd['median_s']/base['median_s']-1<=allowance,answers_and_counts_match=True)
    comparisons.append(item)
    print('COMPARE',case,{mode:round(value['median_s'],6) for mode,value in summary.items()},'PASS' if item['within_tolerance'] else 'REGRESSION',flush=True)

changes={}
for p in (root/'src').rglob('*.mojo'):
    name=str(p.relative_to(root));sha=digest(p)
    if original['sources'].get(name)!=sha:changes[name]=dict(before=original['sources'].get(name),after=sha)
record=dict(schema=1,utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),scope='SIMD for existing checked Int64 CAD transforms; unchanged arbitrary-precision and floating-point paths.',policy=policy,passed=all(x['within_tolerance'] for x in comparisons),builds=builds,validation=validation,quick_checks=load(folder/'quick-checks.json'),profile=load(folder/'profile.json'),microbenchmark=load(folder/'micro.json'),comparisons=comparisons,records=records,source_changes=changes,scripts={name:(folder/name).read_text() for name in ('measure.py','validate.py','micro.py')},notes=[
    'Original is the frozen post-bookkeeping binary. Its codec differs from the committed baseline only by the already-recorded trailing blank line removal. Other source changes are listed explicitly.',
    'Packed scalar and SIMD have identical packing, variation scanning, overflow guards and work charging; only the paired Taylor-shift arithmetic specialization changes.',
    'Each timed process makes one public accepted call and one extra complete scalar check. The extra check is excluded from accepted_ns. Answers and all listed construction diagnostics match the frozen baseline.',
    'Runs are interleaved by variant, pinned to CPU 0, after all task compilation. Shared-host contention is uncontrolled.',
    'The regression screen is not a significance test; raw ranges and paired measurements are retained.'])
path=root/'benchmarks/results/revision-16-native-simd-2026-10-24.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('REPORT',path,'passed',record['passed'],flush=True)
assert record['passed'],'a measured regression needs investigation'

Packed scalar and SIMD have identical packing, variation scanning, overflow guards and work charging; only the paired Taylor-shift arithmetic specialization changes.

Each timed process makes one public accepted call and one extra complete scalar check. The extra check is excluded from accepted_ns. Answers and all listed construction diagnostics match the frozen baseline.
Runs are interleaved by variant, pinned to CPU 0, after all task compilation. Shared-host contention is uncontrolled.
The regression screen is not a significance test; raw ranges and paired measurements are retained.
The experiment passed the preset regression screen; that did not demonstrate a useful overall speedup. The candidate was therefore not selected as the production default.

Initial validation and full-CAD measurements refer to the integrated experimental snapshots. Final validation covers the subsequent explicit opt-in/default arrangement; both source versions are retained.

The final native/scalar default, wide transform and subdivision bodies are checked against the pre-experiment source. The new direct test compares the default scalar, opt-in paired and arbitrary-precision paths.
The paired and scalar full-CAD kernels are outlined functions with distinct machine instructions; identical caller sizes do not mean the switch was ignored.

policy.reason: The first comparison shows small higher SIMD medians on x-axis and simplified edges. Repeat these two cases to investigate rather than infer a gain from the kernel timer.
policy.order: Rotate first variant each repetition; fixed eight repetitions, no early stopping.

targeted_repeat.script:
"""Resolve the small increases seen on x-axis and simplified edges; fixed count."""
import datetime,json,os,statistics,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from benchmarks.harness.measure import run
folder=root/'.cache/cad-native-simd'
base=json.loads((root/'benchmarks/results/revision-16-native-simd-2026-10-24.json').read_text())
policy=dict(reason='The first comparison shows small higher SIMD medians on x-axis and simplified edges. Repeat these two cases to investigate rather than infer a gain from the kernel timer.',repetitions=8,cases=['x-axis-ellipse-problem','simplified-edges-square-product'],variants=['original','packed-scalar','simd'],cpu=0,timeout_s=1800,order='Rotate first variant each repetition; fixed eight repetitions, no early stopping.',utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
(folder/'repeat-policy.json').write_text(json.dumps(policy,indent=2)+'\n')
report=dict(policy=policy,records=[],comparisons=[])
for index,name in enumerate(policy['cases']):
    case='full-bank-'+name;source=root/'.cache/cad-bookkeeping/candidate'/case/case
    expected=set((source/'final.answer').read_text().splitlines());timings={mode:[] for mode in policy['variants']}
    expected_record=json.loads((source.parent/'report.json').read_text())['results'][0]['records'][0]
    keys=('cells_by_level','cells','stacks','factors','compact','revision15','materializations','field_map_hits','max_field_degree','construction_retries','native_nodes','wide_nodes','exact_fallbacks')
    for repetition in range(policy['repetitions']):
        order=policy['variants'];rotation=(repetition+index)%3;order=order[rotation:]+order[:rotation]
        for mode in order:
            work=folder/'repeat'/case/mode/str(repetition);work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            binary=Path(base['builds'][mode]['directory'])/'cad-public'
            resource=run([str(binary),'final',str(source/'input.txt'),str(work/'answer'),'1'],cwd=root,env=os.environ.copy(),timeout_s=1800,memory_bytes=None,cpu=0,stdout=work/'stdout',stderr=work/'stderr').as_dict()
            assert resource['returncode']==0 and not resource['timed_out']
            rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (work/'stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
            assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['check_ok'] and set((work/'answer').read_text().splitlines())==expected
            assert all(rows[0][k]==expected_record[k] for k in keys)
            report['records'].append(dict(case=case,variant=mode,repetition=repetition,record=rows[0],resource=resource))
            timings[mode].append(rows[0]['accepted_ns']/1e9)
        print('DONE',case,repetition+1,flush=True)
    summary={mode:dict(median_s=statistics.median(values),range_s=[min(values),max(values)],raw_s=values) for mode,values in timings.items()}
    item=dict(case=case,timings=summary,simd_vs_original=summary['simd']['median_s']/summary['original']['median_s']-1,simd_vs_packed=summary['simd']['median_s']/summary['packed-scalar']['median_s']-1)
    report['comparisons'].append(item)
    print('COMPARE',case,{mode:round(row['median_s'],6) for mode,row in summary.items()},flush=True)
    (folder/'repeat.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
report['script']=Path(__file__).read_text()
(folder/'repeat.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

adoption.reason: The native kernel is faster in isolation, but the initial complete-CAD comparison and fixed targeted repeat establish no useful accepted-call improvement. Retain the scalar default.
